notes: «ح» splits two routes that meet at «كلاهما عن الزهري» (after the last ح): the Zuhri level and «بهذا الإسناد» are the shared tail

«وفي حديث الليث من رواية ابن رمح أنه سمع أبا مسعود» names a different transmitter in one version: a variant group; the pronoun «أنه» is unclear between Layth and Ibn Ramh's narration, so the variant reads Layth as the one who heard him
«مثله» is a wording note: left out
